textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · Fit Body, Fit Mind, Fit Nation · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Mistakes are things done wrongly. Proudly means with a feeling of pride. Pace is the speed at which we move. Rhythm is a regular beat in music or movement. Cheerful means happy. Swift means very fast.

beats.en: A word that tells more about a noun is called an adjective. Blue sky, hardworking children, green leaves, pebbled road and healthy vegetables are examples.
